Name: The Living Valley - Daulton and Maple NPC Pack
Author: mariachaaan
Description:
[color=#c28865][size=6][b]Daulton & Maple TLV NPC Pack[/b][/size][/color]

This mod is a content expansion for [b]The Living Valley[/b]. It integrates the custom NPCs Daulton and his companion Maple into the TLV ecosystem, allowing them to participate in dynamic systems such as rumors, town events, and complex NPC interactions.

[youtube]-2bh4bYr8rw[/youtube]

[color=#c28865][size=4][b]The Story[/b][/size][/color]

Daulton is a rugged dockhand who traded the chaos of Zuzu City for the quiet rhythms of Pelican Town. Working alongside Willy at the fish shop by day and unwinding at the Saloon by night, he's built a life of honest work and simple pleasures.

But Daulton didn't come alone. Maple - his mischievous, food-motivated rabbit companion - keeps him on his toes. She has her own daily routines, strong opinions, and a talent for stealing socks. Together, they're a package deal.

[color=#c28865][size=4][b]Key TLV Features Included[/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][b]Full Persona Integration[/b]
Daulton's practical, dry-witted personality and Maple's sassy, food-obsessed nature are fully mapped into TLV's dialogue and behavior systems. [*][b]Dynamic Rumors & Articles[/b]
Citizens gossip about the Zuzu City transplant and his unusual rabbit - from dock work stories to late-night Saloon visits. [*][b]Social Web[/b]
Deep connections with Willy (coworker), Sandy and Sam (best friends), Sebastian (friendly rivalry), and Marlon at the Adventurer's Guild. [*][b]Quest Proposals & Town Events[/b]
Allows Daulton to trigger unique TLV-style quests and participate in town-wide events. Maple joins in with her own move-in event when Daulton marries. [*][b]Timeline Anchors[/b]
Narrative progression synced with major world events such as dock visits, Saloon evenings, and Maple encounters. [/list]

[color=#c28865][size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color]

To use this pack, you must install:

[list=1]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42597]The Living Valley[/url] - The core framework.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35087]Daulton and Maple - A Custom NPC Mod[/url] - The original NPC mod; this pack acts as a bridge.
[/list]

[color=#c28865][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][/color]

[list=1]
[*]Install all required mods listed above.
[*]Download this pack and extract it into your [b]Mods[/b] folder.
[*]Confirm that the folder [color=#c28865][code][TLV] Daulton and Maple[/code][/color] is present.
[/list]

[color=#c28865][size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*]Compatible with all mods that support the base Daulton NPC mod.
[*]Designed for The Living Valley version 0.4.0 or higher.
[*]Works with Stardew Valley Expanded and vanilla installations.
[/list]

[b][color=#ff7700]Credits to bigsquishy0 [/color][/b]
